Covalent Modification (PSM).description: Describe covalent post-synthetic modifications to the framework, including linker functionalization (e.g., nucleophilic addition, oxidation/reduction, grafting), linker exchange, linker scissoring, or in-situ polymerization.

Coordination and Ionic Modification.description: Describe coordination or ionic modifications, including metalation (metal exchange or coordination) and ion exchange (cationic or anionic).

Host-Guest Assembly.description: Describe host–guest interactions or inclusions, such as guest encapsulation, exchange, in-situ encapsulation, post-synthetic infiltration, or integration of catalysts, photosensitizers, luminophores, or nanoparticles.

Morphological and Composite Modification.description: Describe changes to morphology or formation of composites, including exfoliation, composite formation, COF-on-substrate structures, mixed-matrix membranes, core–shell architectures, processing treatments, or aerogel/hydrogel formation.
